body.query: Who led FriskAI's latest funding round?

results.title: FriskAI launches with $3.6M to show enterprises what their AI agents are doing - SiliconANGLE
results.author: Duncan Riley
highlights: MaC Venture Capital Management led FriskAI’s round. Wischoff Ventures joined, along with New Enterprise Associates Inc. partner Rick Yang and a group of angel investors. Marlon Nichols, managing partner at MaC Venture Capital, likened the opportunity to what Amazon Web Services Inc. was to cloud and Cisco Systems Inc. was to the early internet and said the FriskAI team has built “the infrastructure layer that lets companies see what their agents are doing.” The company’s website also lists Detroit Venture Partners among its backers.

I’m excited to publicly announce FriskAI, and our $3.6M pre-seed round. The round was led by MaC Venture Capital, joined by Wischoff Ventures, Rick Yang, and a small group of angels. Enterprises are putting agents into production faster than they can understand them, and the tools they already own were built for software that follows a script. Agents choose their own path. When a script breaks you get a stack trace, but when an agent does the wrong thing you get a successful API call. Runtime intelligence for agents is going to be table stakes, and it does not exist yet. We're building it. Grateful to Jonathan Ikpeazu, Michael Marchand, Delane Parnell and to everyone who backed us early. If you're running agents in production and can't say what they did last week, I'd love to talk: neel@friskai.com. https://lnkd.in/gDmwkUK5

results.title: FriskAI Raises $3.6M Pre-Seed for AI Agent Runtime Intelligence | Signalbase
highlights: The funding comes from Mac Venture Capital, Wischoff Ventures, Rick Yang, and Detroit Venture Partners. FriskAI’s pitch is straightforward: give enterprises a clear read on their AI agents’ behavior in real-world use, so they can push deployments forward without flying blind. The round backs a product aimed at closing the gap between shipping AI and trusting it.
